name: sharp-image
title: Sharp Image
description: Fast image compression and format conversion using Sharp (WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPEG)
author: huan_hao

commands.name: to-webp
commands.title: Convert to WebP
commands.description: Convert selected images to WebP format

commands.name: to-avif
commands.title: Convert to AVIF
commands.description: Convert selected images to AVIF format

commands.name: compress
commands.title: Compress Image
commands.description: Compress selected images while keeping the original format

commands.name: settings
commands.title: Compression Settings
commands.description: Configure compression quality and output settings

preferences.name: sharpPath
preferences.title: Sharp CLI Path
preferences.description: Full path to sharp command. Run 'which sharp' in terminal to find it.

preferences.name: outputToSource
preferences.title: Output to Source Directory
preferences.label: Save to source directory
preferences.description: Save compressed images in the same directory as the original

preferences.name: customOutputDir
preferences.title: Custom Output Directory
preferences.description: Directory to save compressed images (used when 'Output to Source Directory' is disabled)

preferences.name: webpQuality
preferences.title: WebP Quality
preferences.description: Quality for WebP compression (1-100, higher is better quality)

preferences.name: avifQuality
preferences.title: AVIF Quality
preferences.description: Quality for AVIF compression (1-100, higher is better quality)

preferences.name: jpegQuality
preferences.title: JPEG Quality
preferences.description: Quality for JPEG compression (1-100, higher is better quality)

preferences.name: overwriteOriginal
preferences.title: Overwrite Original
preferences.label: Overwrite original file
preferences.description: Replace the original file instead of creating a new one

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
